assessment: This preclinical study reports on a novel strategy for sepsis. Sepsis induced by Group A Streptococcus (GAS) in mice leads to depletion of bone marrow HSPCs and mortality and infusion of naive donor HSPCs lower mortality but has no effect on bacterial burden. This supports that HSPCs infusion might attenuate the detrimental immune response in sepsis warranting further investigation of this novel concept.
